title: Repairing the Barton Springs wall
subtitle: The city's schedule for the 1917 retaining wall on the pool's eastern edge
source: City of Austin Parks and Recreation
alt: Timeline of the City of Austin's repair schedule for the 1917 stone retaining wall at Barton Springs Pool: tree removal of 37 trees begins Sept. 8, 2026; vegetation and vine clearing in September 2026; a structural engineer's assessment in fall and winter 2026; and masonry reconstruction beginning in early 2027

events.label: Tree removal begins
events.note: 37 trees inside the wall's zone of influence

events.label: Vegetation and vines cleared
events.note: Opens the wall to a structural engineer
